items.title: File Widerspruch against contribution assessment
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift bei der Allgemeinen Musterkasse, Gesundheitsplatz 5, 30159 Musterstadt, zu erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 21 May 2026. For a social-law letter (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: Mon 25 May 2026 (this day does not shift even though it falls on Pfingstmontag, a public holiday, per social-law rules). The one-month objection period (§ 84 SGG) starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later on the same-numbered day: Thu 25 June 2026 (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB). That day is a normal business day, so no further shift applies.

items.title: First monthly contribution (June 2026) due by direct debit
items.quote: Die Beiträge werden jeweils zum 15. des Folgemonats per Lastschrift eingezogen.
items.computation: Voluntary membership starts 01.06.2026, so the first month covered is June 2026. Contributions are collected on the 15th of the following month, i.e. 15 July 2026. 15 July 2026 falls on a Wednesday, a normal business day, so no weekend/holiday shift is needed. Later months follow the same 15th-of-the-following-month pattern (recurring, only the first due date is given as an example).

warnings: The contributions (530.85 € total, made up of 412.65 € health and 118.20 € nursing care insurance) are collected automatically by direct debit (Lastschrift) each month on the 15th of the following month; verify the debiting account matches your own and that no other IBAN is involved.
